title: Structured question polish: wrapped option indent, 4 options in a short pane, alert wording, dash in Recommend, digit edge tests

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S111 later notes (2026-10-25): wrapped option text is not indented at narrow widths; options 3-4 of a 4-option question can drop silently in a 3-6 line pane (no test or golden); a question group heading instead of Paused; alert wording '! owner questions 1' should read '! 1 owner question'; 'Recommend: N - reason' should accept an en or em dash; untested: an out-of-range digit does nothing, digits after t reach the field.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestWrappedOptionIndents; TestFourOptionsInShortPaneNeverDropSilently; TestAlertWordingSingular; TestRecommendAcceptsDashes; TestOutOfRangeDigitDoesNothing; TestDigitsAfterTReachTheField; goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code. Owner to confirm the group heading wording at preflight. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/tui; go test ./internal/tui -update and review; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
